milestones.title: M1 Hardening & onboarding
milestones.description: Make the working MVP robust across browsers and ready for real users.

milestones.title: M2 Evidence & quality
milestones.description: Stronger validation, better models, evaluated AI feedback.

tasks.title: Set up branch protection, CODEOWNERS teams and the project board
tasks.description: Replace placeholder teams in .github/CODEOWNERS, protect main (PR + green CI + code-owner review), create the project board columns and labels.

tasks.title: Run the browser E2E test in CI
tasks.description: Add a workflow job that starts backend + frontend and runs e2e/practice-flow.cjs with Playwright and cached models.

tasks.title: Cross-browser recording test matrix
tasks.description: Verify recording, auto-stop and upload on Chrome, Firefox, Safari (macOS/iOS) and Edge; document results.

tasks.title: Microphone check before the first word
tasks.description: Onboarding step with a live level meter and a test recording so users fix volume/noise before practising.
acceptance: Detects silence/too quiet using the same thresholds as the backend

tasks.title: Accessibility audit and fixes
tasks.description: Run axe-core and a screen-reader pass (NVDA/VoiceOver) over every page; fix issues; add automated axe checks to tests.

tasks.title: Phoneme timeline on results
tasks.description: Use phoneme start/end times to highlight the problem sound while replaying the user's recording.

tasks.title: Rate limiting and request quotas
tasks.description: Per-user limits for /pronunciation/analyze and /feedback to protect CPU and LLM costs.

tasks.title: Password reset and refresh tokens
tasks.description: Email-based reset flow (pluggable mail sender) and short-lived access tokens with refresh.

tasks.title: Custom word management
tasks.description: Admin CLI/API to add words using CMUdict/espeak G2P (speech_analysis.phoneme_analysis.lexicon) with review step.
acceptance: New word scored end to end

tasks.title: Validate and calibrate the wav2vec2 engine
tasks.description: Download facebook/wav2vec2-lv-60-espeak-cv-ft, run evaluate_speechocean762 + fit_calibration, compare with Allosaurus; switch default if better.

tasks.title: Human reference recordings
tasks.description: Record (or source with licence) reference audio for all words by trained speakers; loudness-normalise into data/reference_audio.

tasks.title: Model-based syllable detection
tasks.description: Replace the energy-based nucleus counter with vowel posteriors from the phoneme engine; measure on fixtures.

tasks.title: Consented isolated-word dataset rated by SLPs
tasks.description: Protocol, consent flow and rating tool to collect isolated-word recordings with expert phone ratings for validation.

tasks.title: Learned scorer on GOP features
tasks.description: Train a GOPT-style regressor on GOP features (speechocean762 train + SP-4 data); keep monotone calibration as fallback.
acceptance: Phone PCC improvement on held-out data

tasks.title: Evaluation set for AI feedback
tasks.description: Build a rubric-graded eval (grounded, actionable, encouraging, no diagnosis) over recorded analyses; report per provider/model.

tasks.title: Child-friendly feedback tone
tasks.description: Use FeedbackRequest.audience to adapt wording (shorter sentences, playful cues) for both LLM and rule-based paths.

tasks.title: SLP review of the articulation knowledge base
tasks.description: Have a speech-language pathologist review ai_feedback/knowledge/articulation.json and the contrast tips.

tasks.title: Privacy review and data retention
tasks.description: DPIA, retention job for recordings, audit log for data access, documented processors (LLM provider).

tasks.title: Practitioner and caregiver roles
tasks.description: Role-based access so a therapist or caregiver can assign word lists and view a learner's progress with consent.

tasks.title: Practitioner dashboard
tasks.description: Views for assigning practice sets and reviewing learners' sound-level progress.
acceptance: Usable with keyboard and screen reader

tasks.title: Minimal-pair exercises
tasks.description: Exercise type contrasting two words (ship/sheep, bit/beat) using existing vowel_contrast words.

tasks.title: Short phrase practice
tasks.description: Extend the pipeline to multi-word phrases (the GOP code already handles sentences in evaluation).
